# 🏆 Kaggle Grandmaster Tabular Stacking & Blending Matrix
**The definitive empirical benchmark of Out-Of-Fold (OOF) prediction matrices, ground truth targets, and optimal blending algorithms across 10 top Kaggle competitions.**

Curated and maintained by **[Berat Erol Çelik (@beraterolelk)](https://www.kaggle.com/beraterolelk)** · Kaggle Notebooks & Datasets Expert.

---

## 🔬 Overview & Significance

Ensembling is the single most decisive factor distinguishing Kaggle Grandmaster winning solutions from standard baselines. However, public discussions rarely release raw **Out-Of-Fold (OOF) prediction matrices** alongside exact mathematical weights, leaving practitioners to speculate about ensembling mechanics.

This dataset provides:
1. **10+ Verified Competition Benchmarks:** Comparing single best models, simple mean, SLSQP probability weighting, and Nelder-Mead simplex rank blending.
2. **Raw OOF Prediction Matrices:** Complete multi-model probability streams with ground truth targets from active competitions (Playground S6E10 Airline Satisfaction, S6E9 EV Purchase, Store Sales, House Prices).
3. **Machine-Readable Weights Vault (`optimal_ensemble_weights_vault.json`):** Exact simplex weights and power exponents ready for drop-in reproduction.
4. **Drop-in Python Implementation (`grandmaster_blending_quickstart.py`):** Standalone `NelderMeadRankBlender` and `SLSQPProbabilityWeighter` classes.

---

## 📊 Summary Benchmark Table

| Competition | Task Type | Metric | Single Best Model | SLSQP Blend | Nelder-Mead Rank Blend | Lift Margin | Winning Algorithm |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Playground S6E10** | Binary Class | ROC-AUC | 0.99599 (LGBM) | 0.99592 | **0.99614** | **+0.00015** | Nelder-Mead Simplex Rank Blending |
| **Playground S6E9** | Binary Class | ROC-AUC | 0.94656 (OrderedTE) | 0.94680 | **0.94712** | **+0.00056** | Lexsort Tie-Breaking + Nelder-Mead |
| **Playground S6E8** | Binary Class | ROC-AUC | 0.89340 (CatBoost) | 0.89485 | **0.89520** | **+0.00180** | Nelder-Mead Simplex Rank Blending |
| **Playground S6E7** | Regression | RMSE | 0.5412 (LGBM) | **0.5361** | 0.5360 | **-0.0052** | SLSQP Constrained Least Squares |
| **Store Sales** | Time Series | RMSLE | 0.3982 (LGBM Resids) | **0.3920** | 0.3925 | **-0.0062** | 2-Stage Linear Trend + Residual Stacking |
| **House Prices** | Regression | RMSLE | 0.1245 (CatBoost) | **0.1218** | 0.1216 | **-0.0029** | SLSQP + Power Exponentiation (p=1.2) |
| **Spaceship Titanic** | Binary Class | Accuracy | 0.8125 (LGBM) | 0.8195 | **0.8220** | **+0.0095** | Nelder-Mead Simplex Rank Blending |
| **Titanic** | Binary Class | Accuracy | 0.8428 (CatBoost) | 0.8541 | **0.8585** | **+0.0157** | Nelder-Mead Simplex Rank Blending |
| **Playground S6E6** | Binary Class | ROC-AUC | 0.8845 (LGBM) | 0.8882 | **0.8895** | **+0.0050** | Power Blending (p=2.0) + Nelder-Mead |
| **Playground S6E5** | Multi-Class | Accuracy | 0.8350 (LGBM) | 0.8410 | **0.8432** | **+0.0082** | Class-Wise SLSQP Weighter |

---

## 🧠 Algorithmic Formulation

### 1. Nelder-Mead Simplex Rank Blending (ROC-AUC & Accuracy)
ROC-AUC depends strictly on the **concordance of pairs**, not calibrated cross-entropy:
$$\text{AUC} = \frac{\sum_{i \in \text{pos}} \sum_{j \in \text{neg}} \mathbf{1}_{[\hat{y}_i > \hat{y}_j]}}{N_{\text{pos}} \cdot N_{\text{neg}}}$$
Because the indicator derivative is zero almost everywhere, derivative-free Nelder-Mead directly optimizes weights over rank-transformed vectors:
$$R_{\text{blend}} = \sum_{m=1}^{M} w_m \cdot \text{Rank}(\hat{P}_m), \quad \text{where } \sum w_m = 1, \quad w_m \ge 0$$

### 2. SLSQP Constrained Least Squares (Regression RMSE/RMSLE)
Minimizes residual variance subject to the L1 probability simplex:
$$\min_{\mathbf{w}} \| \mathbf{y} - \sum_{m=1}^M w_m \hat{\mathbf{y}}_m \|_2^2 \quad \text{s.t.} \quad \sum_{m=1}^M w_m = 1, \quad w_m \ge 0$$

---

## 💻 Quickstart Usage

```python
import pandas as pd
from grandmaster_blending_quickstart import NelderMeadRankBlender

# 1. Load S6E10 OOF benchmark matrix
df = pd.read_csv("s6e10_airline_passenger_satisfaction_oof_matrix.csv")
y_true = df["target_ground_truth"].values
oofs = [
    df["oof_pred_lightgbm"].values,
    df["oof_pred_xgboost"].values,
    df["oof_pred_catboost"].values
]

# 2. Fit Nelder-Mead Rank Blender
blender = NelderMeadRankBlender(maximize=True)
blender.fit(oofs, y_true)
print("Optimal Simplex Weights:", blender.weights_)
```
